description:
Implement quantized (fixed-point) LLR representations for embedded and GPU targets. Research 3-8 bit precision vs accuracy tradeoff. Relevant for GPU acceleration (can 8-bit quantized LLRs match FP32 accuracy?) and embedded SDR targets.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Delivers “Implement fixed-point LLR quantization strategies” with the behavior, scope, evidence, and constraints described above.
title: Implement fixed-point LLR quantization strategies
